prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Region: Thestra Level: 50 Coordinates: Description: It's in the Swamps of Rumug. In the center of the chunk there is an island, with a bridge going over a chasm. Careful on your way up. There are a few see-invis mobs, but nothing you can't avoid. Jump off the side into the chasm, and swim under the water to a hole or enter the dry cave to get into Lair of the Mnalus (see the map on this site). Keep going until you reach the main chamber, look around and you should be able to see it from the pool. You can invis the whole way but there are a couple mobs near the king that will see you if you are not careful.

prose_evidence.text_as_printed: Region: Thestra Level: 50 Coordinates: Description: You will need 1 undead invis carving to get there. Enter Old Targonor Keep from the front door entrance. Take a quick right, and you will go through a doorway and on your right is a staircase down. Head down till your first T intersection there you will make a left. Next T intersection you make a another left. Next T you will make a right, the gestalt is in the back right corner of this room. I didnt have any problems sticking to the right wall and walking back to it, but there could possibly be a see thru invis named up for all know so be careful. Once your behind it you can lul the mob right in front of it and click away. I thought he wasnt going to agro since facing the other way so i died getting it. But as all other gestalts if you die while the click is in process you still learn it while dead.
